BL-900 — Promotion ranking should consider the containing epic's priority ahead of the child ticket's own priority, leaving the expedite bucket, queue-jump and ambulance untouched
What it solves: Gherkin parked as `.feature.draft` per BL-233; the coder promotes it and
wires handlers in the same commit.
Approval context: Two judgement calls are mine, not the intake's, and both change observable ordering — say so if you disagree. (1) An epic id with MORE THAN ONE tracker ranks by its most urgent (lowest) tracker priority; this is real today, `swarm-intelligence-layer` has three trackers at 30/31/35. (2) A candidate …
BL-900 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-900" (or "reject BL-900 <reason>") to act.
